intent: Individual textile/cleaning word lesson:blanket,two contextual sheet senses,towel,uncountable soap/bar,brush noun/verb and es,bucket count/capacity,broom,uncountable rubbish with explicit regional comparison. Three original neutral picture tasks,six own-form lists and two base-only mass nouns,new sentences,changed blanket/sheet rewrites and fresh paper/twelve-litre transfer remain draft.
picturePurpose: Original blanket/towel/broom panels support identification,not literal source-example locations or capacity. Exact text and quantities are authored in code. No image-based counting or audio claim.

workshop.title: 认物品、分用法，再完成新清洁计划
workshop.instruction: 先点图或读句子判断，再填词、写自己的例子。最后读新计划，算清桶数与水量。

transfer.stem: Which action follows the new clean-up plan?
transfer.passage:
CLEAN-UP PLAN
Bring two sheets of paper for the room labels; leave the bed sheets where they are. Put one clean towel and two bars of soap beside the sink. We need three buckets of water. Each bucket will hold four litres, so fill all three. Use the soft brush for the shoes and the broom for the floor. Put the rubbish in the outside bin. Leave the blanket on the bed; it is not a cleaning cloth.

options.text: Bring two pieces of paper and prepare twelve litres of water.
Bring two bed sheets and prepare twelve litres of water.
Bring two pieces of paper and prepare three litres of water.
Use the blanket to clean the floor and leave the rubbish inside.

answer.display: Bring two pieces of paper and prepare twelve litres of water.

explanation.strategy: 先按搭配确定物品，再用本次给出的数量和容量计算；不能沿用旧例句。

steps.text: 三桶水，每桶四升，总共需要十二升。
steps.reason: 这次给出每桶容量：3×4=12。不能把三桶当成三升，也不能套用前题未给容量时的结论。

distractors.reason: 水量算对了，但把paper忽略后错拿了床单。
三桶不等于三升；每桶四升，总量是十二升。
